Repeat.

Holding priority, activate Shrieking Drake by tapping it, adding {U}.

When the Clue enters as a 0/0 creature due to March of the Machines, it dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness.
Summoning Station triggers, untapping it.

When the persist creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the persist creature enters, Support Mission triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on that creature.

4153-4247--5--195.notablePrerequisites: At least one persist creature has a +1/+1 counter on it.
4153-4247--5--195.description:
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing the persist creature that has a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, its persist ability and Resourceful Defense trigger.
Resolve Resourceful Defense's ability, putting at least two +1/+1 counters onto the surviving persist creature due to the counter-increasing effect.
If that creature had a -1/-1 counter on it, remove that and one of the +1/+1 counters from it as a state-based action.
Resolve the persist ability from step 2, returning the persist creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability from step 1.
Repeat.

1981-2415-4506-6798.easyPrerequisites:

1981-2415-4506-6798.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Havoc Jester triggers, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Auriok Champion triggers, causing you to gain life
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat.

824-2728-4153-5231.easyPrerequisites:
Genestealer Patriarch does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent controls a creature.
Leech Bonder is tapped and does not have summoning sickness.
824-2728-4153-5231.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two additional creatures.
824-2728-4153-5231.description:
Declare Genestealer Patriarch as an attacker.
Genestealer Patriarch's first ability triggers, putting an infection counter on a creature an opponent controls.
Activate Leech Bonder's ability by paying its cost, moving the infection counter from the opponent's creature onto a creature you control.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing the creature with an infection counter on it, adding {R}.
When the creature dies, Resourceful Defense and Genestealer Patriarch's second ability trigger.
Resolve the Resourceful Defense trigger, putting an infection counter onto another creature you control.
Resolve the Genestealer Patriarch trigger, causing you to create a token copy of the sacrificed creature that is a Tyranid in addition to its other types.
Repeat from step 4.

1479-2841-6156-7889.easyPrerequisites:
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Bad River.
1479-2841-6156-7889.description:
Fetch a land using Bad River.
When the fetched land enters, Dancing from Dark to Dawn and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and Dancing from Dark to Dawn trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Dancing from Dark to Dawn from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Dancing from Dark to Dawn triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

1753-3259-7796.notablePrerequisites: At least one opponent cannot block creatures you control.
1753-3259-7796.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached and Precinct Captain, triggering Breath of Fury and Precinct Captain.
Resolve the Precinct Captain trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

215-1526-6968.description:
Activate Circle of Dreams Druid by tapping it, adding an amount of {G}.

670-1619-1734-6136.notablePrerequisites: You are currently venturing in Tomb of Annihilation in the Trapped Entry room.
670-1619-1734-6136.description:
Cast Fiend Hunter by paying its mana cost.
When Fiend Hunter enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
Resolve the Fiend Hunter trigger, exiling Avenging Hunter.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Fiend Hunter.
When Fiend Hunter dies, it triggers, returning Avenging Hunter from exile to the battlefield.
When Avenging Hunter enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
Resolve the Avenging Hunter trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Fiend Hunter from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Fiend Hunter enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
Resolve the Fiend Hunter trigger, exiling Avenging Hunter.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger from step 10, venturing into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger from step 6, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Fiend Hunter.
Repeat from step 5.

2921-5170-6132-6772.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Metamorphosis Fanatic.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic dies, Syr Vondam triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Syr Vondam trigger.
Resolve the Syr Vondam trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Metamorphosis Fanatic from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat.

Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat

Cast Sensei's Divining Top from exile by paying {0}.
Repeat.

Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and Springheart Nantuko trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.

Resolve the Vein Ripper trigger, causing you to gain 2 life and target opponent to lose 2 life.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Cast Golgari Thug from the top of your library by paying 2 life.
Repeat.

3234-3293-4693-5686.easyPrerequisites: You control a Plains or have a Plains in your graveyard.
3234-3293-4693-5686.description:
Activate Overgrown Estate by sacrificing a land.
Repeat step 1 until you control no lands.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing World Shaper.
When World Shaper dies, it triggers, return all lands from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the lands enter, Emeria Shepherd triggers that many times.
Resolve an Emeria Shepherd trigger that was triggered by a Plains, returning World Shaper from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve all remaining Emeria Shepherd triggers.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat
3234-3293-4693-5686.notes: You can return all nonland permanents in your graveyard and library to the battlefield if you control there are two or more Plains between your graveyard, library and battlefield. To do this, have all triggers from Emeria Shepherd target desired permanents. Then, resolve the Plains triggers first to return those cards to the battlefield, causing all other triggers to fizzle on the stack.

Repeat each turn.

Put all but one Éomer token into your graveyard due to the legend rule, causing you to get at least one Éomer trigger, causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
At the end of your combat phase, Altaïr triggers, causing you to exile the Éomer token.
Repeat each combat phase.

Resolve the Naga Fleshcrafter ability, untapping Kiora's Follower.

Resolve both Cloudstone Curio triggers, returning Deepglow Skate and the additional creature to your hand from the battlefield.
Repeat.

790-4179-5919.notablePrerequisites: A player has a number of cards in hand that is greater than or equal to 10 minus the lowest amount of poison counters an opponent has.
790-4179-5919.description:
Cast Triumph of the Hordes by paying {2}{G}{G}, giving creatures you control infect until end of turn.
Cast Windfall by paying {2}{U}, causing each player to discard their hand and then draw a number of cards equal to the greatest number of cards a player discarded this way.
Razorkin Needlehead triggers for each card drawn this way, giving each opponent a poison counter for each card they drew.
Each opponent loses the game due to having ten or more poison counters

3750-4050-5324.notablePrerequisites: You control a non-Gnome creature that does not have summoning sickness. Anim Pakal has at least four +1/+1 counters on it. An opponent cannot block and kill creatures you control.

Activate Aggravated Assault by paying {3}{R}{R}, causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat and main phase after this one.
Repeat.

 Move to your next turn.
Activate Isochron Scepter by paying {2} and tapping it, casting a copy of Final Fortune, causing you to take an extra turn after this one and to lose the game at the end of that turn.
At the beginning of your end step, the delayed ability of one of the Final Fortune copies triggers, exiling the token The Golden Throne and setting your life total to 1.
Repeat from step 2.

Angel of Glory's Rise enters the battlefield, returning Hostage Taker from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

Activate Mox Amber by tapping it, adding {1}.
